svg.title: Response time vs. concurrent streams
svg.desc: 1544 load-test requests. For each, the number of streams in flight when it started (x) against time to first token, total response time and decode speed. Lines are the median and the slowest 5% per bin of 5 streams; dots are individual requests. The same numbers are in the README table.
svg.text: before: 1 gateway, 0.25 core, 1 msg per token
Streams in flight when the request started
